Hub.get_issue.title: paginate() drops the last item on every page
Hub.get_issue.body:
With 10 items and a page size of 5, page 1 shows items 1-4 and page 2 shows 6-9. Items 5 and 10 never show up.

Steps: call paginate(items, 1, 5).
Expected: 5 items. Got: 4.

Dev.work: paginate() sliced to `end - 1`, so each page lost its last item. I added a failing test for a 10-item list with a page size of 5, changed the slice to `items.slice(start, start + size)`, and ran `npm test`: 12 passed.

Repo.run.stdout:
✓ paginate returns a full page
✓ paginate returns the last page

12 pass
0 fail

yield.reason: The fix is right, but please also handle a page size of 0.
